title: Seagrove "Seaside Views" 320 W Grove Ave
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short 3-minute walk to the public beach - Gulf views from 3rd and 4th floors - Largest private saltwater pool and hot tub this close to Seaside! *Pool heating available for $100 per day* - 8 total parking spots including 2-car garage and low speed vehicle parking spots - 9 adult bikes - Low-Speed Vehicle - In-home elevator - Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (March 1 - October 31)-Peloton Bike - an Alaya exclusive amenity - Game room - Outdoor kitchen with fireplace (Fireplace available Nov – Feb) - Complete Clean Linen Participant—All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Fall in love with the Gulf Coast at stunning Seaside Views—a luxurious 7,000-square-foot home with 9 bedrooms, 10 bathrooms, and 2-half baths that accommodates 28. Only steps from Seaside, all the activities and restaurants are within reach, including a short 3-minute stroll to the beach. At the end of the day, take in majestic sunset views from the fourth-floor deck or unwind in the largest saltwater pool in Seagrove!Outside, splash around in the impressive pool with an attached sitting spa, or gather for cookouts in the outdoor kitchen with a deluxe natural gas grill, comfy seating, and a TV. Inside, the spacious first-floor game room boasts a kitchenette, full-size arcade game, pool table, and 85” TV. Guests can unwind in the guest bedroom with a king bed or the bunk room with a full-over-full and twin-over-twin setup, both with private bathrooms. There’s also a laundry room with 2 washers and dryers.The second floor is the heart of the home, offering open living spaces and a gourmet kitchen outfitted with high-end appliances, dual dishwashers, 3 ovens, and a beverage cooler. A grand 14-foot island and seating for 32 make it easy to dine together. Two luxurious primary bedrooms, each with king beds and private baths, provide a relaxing retreat on this level.Sleep and play abound on the third floor, featuring 5 inviting bedrooms, each with private bathrooms and access to astounding Gulf views from the deck. Highlights include 2 primary bedrooms with king beds and freestanding soaking tubs, a guest bedroom with a king bed and full-over-full bunk, and a bunk room with a twin-over-twin and full-over-full setup. Plus, a large “gaming” bunk room with 2 twin-over-full bunks and 2 arcade games, a PlayStation 5, and 75” TV!For the grand finale, a fourth-floor deck, accessible via elevator or stairs, provides spectacular Gulf views!Seaside Views is an incredible retreat, offering on-site parking for 8 vehicles, including a 2-car garage, along with 9 bikes and 1 low-speed vehicle for exploring the area. There’s even a Peloton bike—no excuses. Beach access is a 3-minute walk away! Book now!*The property contains plants that are toxic to dogs. No Pets allowed.*No Smoking. No Weddings/Events.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin and Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo. body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Seagrove "Seaside Views" 320 W Grove Ave Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 9 Beds 20 Sleeps 28 Full Baths 10 Half Baths 2 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short 3-minute walk to the public beach - Gulf views from 3rd and 4th floors - Largest private saltwater pool and hot tub this close to Seaside! *Pool heating available for $100 per day* - 8 total parking spots including 2-car garage and low speed vehicle parking spots - 9 adult bikes - Low-Speed Vehicle - In-home elevator - Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (March 1 - October 31) -Peloton Bike - an Alaya exclusive amenity - Game room - Outdoor kitchen with fireplace (Fireplace available Nov – Feb) - Complete Clean Linen Participant—All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Fall in love with the Gulf Coast at stunning Seaside Views—a luxurious 7,000-square-foot home with 9 bedrooms, 10 bathrooms, and 2-half baths that accommodates 28. Only steps from Seaside, all the activities and restaurants are within reach, including a short 3-minute stroll to the beach. At the end of the day, take in majestic sunset views from the fourth-floor deck or unwind in the largest saltwater pool in Seagrove! Outside, splash around in the impressive pool with an attached sitting spa, or gather for cookouts in the outdoor kitchen with a deluxe natural gas grill, comfy seating, and a TV. Inside, the spacious first-floor game room boasts a kitchenette, full-size arcade game, pool table, and 85” TV. Guests can unwind in the guest bedroom with a king bed or the bunk room with a full-over-full and twin-over-twin setup, both with private bathrooms. There’s also a laundry room with 2 washers and dryers. The second floor is the heart of the home, offering open living spaces and a gourmet kitchen outfitted with high-end appliances, dual dishwashers, 3 ovens, and a beverage cooler. A grand 14-foot island and seating for 32 make it easy to dine together. Two luxurious primary bedrooms, each with king beds and private baths, provide a relaxing retreat on this level. Sleep and play abound on the third floor, featuring 5 inviting bedrooms, each with private bathrooms and access to astounding Gulf views from the deck. Highlights include 2 primary bedrooms with king beds and freestanding soaking tubs, a guest bedroom with a king bed and full-over-full bunk, and a bunk room with a twin-over-twin and full-over-full setup. Plus, a large “gaming” bunk room with 2 twin-over-full bunks and 2 arcade games, a PlayStation 5, and 75” TV! For the grand finale, a fourth-floor deck, accessible via elevator or stairs, provides spectacular Gulf views! Seaside Views is an incredible retreat, offering on-site parking for 8 vehicles, including a 2-car garage, along with 9 bikes and 1 low-speed vehicle for exploring the area. There’s even a Peloton bike—no excuses. Beach access is a 3-minute walk away! Book now! *The property contains plants that are toxic to dogs. No Pets allowed. *No Smoking. No Weddings/Events.
